# LinkedIn Technical Marketing Post: Sales Commitment & Follow-Up OS

Autonomous promise extraction engine that parses meeting notes, extracts verbal commitments made to prospects ("I will send pricing tomorrow"), and schedules automated drafts.

### The Problem
Most companies lose thousands in hidden operational waste every single month.

### The Engineered Fix
We engineered a zero-dependency system to solve this.

👉 Try the live interactive simulator here:
https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/sales-follow-up-os/

#SoftwareEngineering #Automation #SystemsArchitecture #BuildInPublic
